records.title: Compensation to Farmers in Uttar Pradesh.
details:
a): In the last five years (as on 30.11.2025), a total of 2,08,999 land owners have been awarded the compensation for National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) projects in Uttar Pradesh and 37,247 land owners are yet to received the compensation.
b): Compensation to the tune of RS.66.81 crores and RS. 60.34 crores against land acquisition for NHAI projects is pending for disbursement in the Districts of Kaushambi and Saharanpur respectively.

records.title: Agreement with United Kisan Morcha
details:
(b) to (e): the Government has formed a Committee vide notification dated 18-07-
2022, consisting of representatives of farmers, Central Government, representation of State
Governments, eminent agriculture economists & scientists etc. The Committee is to make
suggestions so as to make Minimum Support Price (MSP) more effective and transparent;
to promote natural farming and to change crop pattern keeping in mind the changing needs
of the country
